name: wordinweb
description: Open-source high-fidelity Word/.docx viewer and editor for the web

scripts.build:demo: npm run build && vite build --config examples/anon-share/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/collab/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/anon-share/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: npm run check:dist && npm run test:packages && npm run test:demo
scripts.test:packages: vitest run --root packages/core && vitest run --root packages/collab && vitest run --root packages/agent && vitest run --root packages/server && vitest run --root packages/react
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && vite build --config examples/anon-share/vite.config.ts
